Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg

Class HostedWindowResizer

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.HostedWindowResizer
public final class HostedWindowResizer extends Object
Bridges window-resize requests from the core window chrome (Frame3DWindowDecoration maximize) to the code that actually owns a hosted window's sizing (TitledSwingWindow in the app modules).

The decoration lives in lg3d-core while the title bar, spine titles, thumbnail and panel sizing of a hosted Swing window are built by the app-side helper, so the decoration cannot resize them directly. The helper registers a HostedWindowResizer.Resizer per Frame3D here at construction; the decoration looks it up when the user maximizes, so a hosted window resizes its content at native text size (like a real JFrame) instead of being uniformly scaled (which magnifies the texture and letterboxes narrow windows). Frames with no registered resizer (pure-3D apps) keep the scale-based maximize.

The registry is a WeakHashMap: entries disappear with their frame, so closed windows never leak.
